criteria.requirement: Isolate caller-owned config before MarkupMachine processing and generate_base_model removes/derives models. Copy built-in dict/list/tuple recursively with shared-alias preservation, retain opaque model/callback identity rather than arbitrary deepcopy, explicitly reject container cycles. Accept read-only outer Mapping by copying dict. Repeated model-code generation and multiple simple/hierarchical machine construction must leave original models/nested states/transitions unchanged. Internal mutable markup behavior remains supported; no promise to freeze arbitrary business objects.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
